verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party feature for issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials to an agent. What it does show are developer building blocks: RLS-scoped user tokens, a Custom Access Token Hook for editing claims, a JWT expiry setting, and the option to sign your own JWTs with an imported key. A developer could construct agent credentials from these, but that does not count as the product shipping the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
